{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Great.'' It's gonna be another one of ''those'' planets.|A world-weary Warthog, upon seeing an Aleena flying a can-cell over Aleen|<ref name="Mercy Mission" />}}
'''Warthog''' was a veteran [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who served as a [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy's]] [[Hunter Squadron (Galactic Republic)|Hunter Squadron]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], often as the [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]] to [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]. [[Cloning/Legends|Born]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], Warthog became a skilled [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and joined his [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] brethren in a number of engagements against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. He became good friends with fellow pilot [[Tracer]], who served as the tail [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] for his [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighter]] during their service in Hunter [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]]. Warthog piloted his Y-wing during the [[Battle of Gwori]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], serving under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] Koon and [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] to cripple the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gwori]]'s [[Gwori shipyards|Separatist shipyards]]. Although the mission was a success, Warthog [[Death/Legends|lost]] Tracer to enemy [[Laser/Legends|fire]] from a [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighter]] while withdrawing from Gwori. At the [[First Battle of Felucia/Legends|First Battle of Felucia]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Warthog flew a [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]], working with Koon to provide starfighter cover for a [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] of [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]]. Warthog and Koon safely escorted the [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] to the surface of [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], where they rescued a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] that had been overrun by the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]].

Besides serving in Hunter Squadron, Warthog was often attached to [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|CC-3636]]'s [[104th Battalion/Legends|104th Battalion]], providing aerial support or piloting one of the [[Battalion/Legends|unit's]] [[Plo's Bros/Legends|gunships]]. The latter was the case during a [[Mission to Aleen/Legends|supply mission]] to [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]], where Warthog ferried 104th [[Troop/Legends|troops]] and relief supplies. Flying a nimble [[Clone Z-95 starfighter/Legends|clone Z-95 starfighter]], Warthog joined Koon in leading a [[Battle of Kadavo/Legends|starfighter assault]] on a [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|slave processing facility]] on [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]], where the Separatist-allied [[Zygerrian Slave Empire/Legends|Zygerrian Slave Empire]] had [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] a number of [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] colonists. Warthog and his [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]] pilots [[Starfighter combat/Legends|eliminated]] the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrians]]' [[HH-87 Starhopper/Legends|HH-87 Starhoppers]] and [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] defenses so that [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Coburn/Legends|Coburn]] could retrieve the Togrutas with the [[Arquitens-class light cruiser/Legends|light cruiser]] [[Hand of Justice/Legends|''Hand of Justice'']].

==Biography==
===Assault on Gwori===
{{Quote|You hear that, Tracer. We stuck it to the clankers good!''"<br />"''I'm letting you&hellip; out of our bet, Warthog&hellip; The fleet&hellip; can buy me a drink&hellip; for this one.''"<br />"''You hang in there, Tracer! We're going home.|Warthog and a dying Tracer|<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" />}}
[[File:HunterSquadron-SOD.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Warthog attends the briefing under Generals Koon and Tiin alongside his tail gunner, Tracer.]]
The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who took the nickname Warthog<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" /> was [[Cloning/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] for service to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Encyclopedia: Clones">{{SWE|groups|clonetroopers|clone troopers}}</ref> Warthog became a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] with the rank of [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Trooper Captain]] and entered the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in which the Republic battled the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] for [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] supremacy.<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" /> By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the war,<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref><ref name="FF-2014 8: Geonosis">{{FactFile2014|8|21 BBY 1-2|The Second Battle of Geonosis}}</ref> Warthog joined the Republic [[Navy/Legends|Navy's]] [[Hunter Squadron (Galactic Republic)|Hunter Squadron]],<ref name="CWA: Starfighter">{{TCWA|Starfighter}}</ref> a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" /> that primarily [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]].<ref name="DB Y-wing">{{DB|starship|ywingstarfighter|Y-wing starfighter}}</ref> Fellow clone pilot [[Tracer]] became the tail [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] for Warthog's Y-wing, and the two pilots formed a close friendship while stationed on the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. On one assignment, Warthog's unit was deployed aboard a Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to an<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="Atlas Companion">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> staging area in the [[Moskk system/Legends|Moskk system]], in preparation to mount an assault on the nearby [[Gwori system/Legends|Gwori system]]. The [[Battle group/Legends|battle group's]] target was the [[Gwori shipyards|primary shipyards]]<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" /> of [[Gwori Revolutionary Industries/Legends|Gwori Revolutionary Industries]],<ref name="DB Banking Clan frigate">{{DB|starship|bankingclanfrigate|Banking Clan communications frigate}}</ref> which produced [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]] for the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] at the planet [[Gwori]].<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" />

As part of the Republic's plan, a small team of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and clones was sent to [[Battle of Gwori|infiltrate]] Gwori to pinpoint the exact location of the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]], so that Hunter Squadron could move in and destroy the facility. Once [[General/Legends|Generals]] Koon and [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] received the coordinates, they called a briefing aboard their [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] to outline the attack strategy to Hunter Squadron. In response to comments from Warthog about their newest "no returner" mission, Tracer bet him ten rotations' worth of drinks that they would survive their assignment. After Koon and Tiin stated that they would be using high-power [[Proton bomb/Legends|proton bombs]] against the enemy facility, a fellow [[Unidentified clone trooper pilot (Hunter Squadron)|pilot]] voiced his concern about reaching the shipyards themselves, as a massive Confederate fleet was [[Blockade/Legends|blockading]] Gwori. Tiin explained that they would be utilizing a precision [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump, a risky maneuver that would allow them to emerge between the blockade and the planet. Warthog asked if the maneuver had been tried before, to which Koon assured the captain that they would not be trying it if it wans't the only way. With all preparations in place, Warthog and Tracer set out aboard their BTL-B Y-wing starfighter with Hunter Squadron, following Koon and Tiin in their [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B interceptors]] to the jump point. The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] and clone pilots managed to safely reach Gwori, bypassing the Separatist blockade and heading for the world's equatorial canyon system, where the shipyards were located. Upon arrival at the shipyards, which were built into the canyon wall, Warthog and his comrades released their proton bombs onto the facility.<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" />

Although Hunter Squadron's [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] landed direct hits to the facility, they failed to do damage beyond the top deck of [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]]. As the clones did not have enough ammunition to whittle away at the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] decks in that manner, Koon had Warthog and the others set their targeting grids for the construction supports, which would compromise the facility's hold on the canyon wall. Circling back around in single-file [[Bantha formation/Legends|Bantha formation]], Warthog and his comrades encountered an incoming squadron of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]], which [[Overseer/Legends|Overseer]] [[Juhm]] had dispatched to protect his facility. Though Tracer managed to hit several [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] with their bomber's [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Laser/Legends|laser]] fire penetrated the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] gunner bubble-turret, and Tracer was hit in the chest. Despite being concerned for his comrade, Warthog released his proton bombs alongside the rest of his unit, hitting the facility's supports and causing it to crash to the bottom of the canyon. With their objective completed, Koon and Tiin ordered Hunter Squadron to meet them at the rendezvous point, and the clones departed to jump to hyperspace. However, Tracer did not survive long enough to receive treatment, succumbing to his injury and [[Death/Legends|dying]] before Warthog left Gwori's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" />

===First Battle of Felucia===
{{Quote|I can't shake these two droids!''"<br />"''Come around and I'll try to get them off your tail.|Warthog and Plo Koon|<ref name="Holocron Heist" />}}
[[File:Warthog_Ep201.png|thumb|right|250px|Warthog tries to escape from droid starfighters over Felucia.]]
Warthog saw action on a number of worlds as part of his service to the Republic.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> At one point, he brought reinforcements to a [[Republic outpost (Warthog)|Republic outpost]] aboard a prototype [[Y-wing scout bomber/Legends|Y-wing scout bomber]].<ref name="Hasbro: Y-Wing Scout Bomber">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|pack=Y-Wing Scout Bomber with Clone Trooper Pilot|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/Y-Wing_Scout_Bomber.asp}}</ref> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], as the Clone Wars entered their second year,<ref name="Holocron Heist Date">{{TCWdates|201}}</ref> Warthog<ref name="Holocron Heist">{{TCW|Holocron Heist}}</ref> and Hunter Squadron,<ref name="CWA: Starfighter" /> flying [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]], served under Koon as part of an [[First Battle of Felucia/Legends|evacuation operation]] at the jungle world of [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].<ref name="Holocron Heist" /> As Koon's [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]],<ref name="Holocron Heist Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode201.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Holocron Heist}}</ref> Warthog joined his fellow clone pilots in providing starfighter cover for the Republic fleet's [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]], which were to retrieve a battle group&mdash;under the command of Jedi Generals [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]&mdash;that had been trapped on the surface by a Separatist blockade.<ref name="Holocron Heist" /> Once Hunter Squadron eliminated one of the enemy ''Munificent''-class frigates over Felucia,<ref name="CWA: Starfighter" /> Koon and Warthog moved in, leading the [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] of [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] through the breach in the blockade with an escort of starfighters. Warthog protected the gunships while Koon [[Starfighter combat/Legends|blasted through]] several Vulture droid starfighters, clearing the way for the rescue vessels.<ref name="Holocron Heist" />

Despite bypassing the first wave of droid starfighters, the Republic convoy was pursued into the planetary atmosphere by more Vulture droids. A pair of them locked onto Warthog's V-19 Torrent, resisting his attempts to evade them. Unable to shake his pursuers, Warthog reported his predicament to Koon, who doubled back in his Delta-7B interceptor,<ref name="Holocron Heist" /> the ''[[Blade of Dorin/Legends|Blade of Dorin]]'',<ref name="Dataclip: Shadow of Malevolence">{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a2505961cd20f84011ce7a789390007|text=Dataclip: Shadow of ''Malevolence''|na=video file}}</ref> to assist his wingman. Koon destroyed one of the droids, with its debris hitting the second droid and causing it to crash in the jungle below, right where Skywalker and Kenobi were situated with their [[Troop/Legends|troops]]. Thanks to Warthog and Koon's escort, the LAAT/i gunships were able to reach the evacuation area and collected Skywalker, Kenobi, and their men. Warthog and his general continued to provide cover after the gunships lifted off, with the convoy also retrieving a clone [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] patrol led by Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], from elsewhere in the jungle. The Republic forces withdrew from Felucia, abandoning the world to the Confederacy for the [[Time/Legends|time]] being.<ref name="Holocron Heist" />

In addition to operations with Hunter Squadron,<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" /> Warthog served with Koon's [[104th Battalion/Legends|104th Battalion]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], often supplying starfighter cover or flying one of the [[Battalion/Legends|unit's]] [[Plo's Bros/Legends|''Plo's Bros'']] gunships to deploy troops onto battlefields.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Later in 21 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Mercy Mission Date">{{TCWdates|405}}</ref> Warthog was part of a 104th task force&mdash;led by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|CC-3636]], nicknamed "Wolffe"&mdash;that was dispatched to block a Separatist annexation of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Qiilura system/Legends|Qiilura system]]. En route there aboard an [[Wolffe's Acclamator-class assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]], the clone detachment was redirected to [[Mission to Aleen/Legends|deliver]] relief supplies to the nearby planet [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]], which had been devastated by [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]].<ref name="Mercy Mission">{{TCW|Mercy Mission (episode)}}</ref> A number of LAAT/i gunships were fully loaded<ref name="Explore: Mercy Mission">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep405|text="Mercy Mission" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> with provision crates and 104th troops, as was one of the Republic [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|assault ship's]] accompanying [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigates]]. Warthog was among the pilots assigned to bring the gunships to Aleen's surface. After launching from the [[Transport/Legends|transport's]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], Warthog did a double take when he caught sight of a native [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] flying a [[Can-cell/Legends|can-cell]] mount, remarking that it would be another one of "those" worlds. Once the pilots had brought their supplies to an Aleena refugee zone and repaired the world's mainframe [[Computer/Legends|computers]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Wolffe recalled their forces from Aleen,<ref name="Mercy Mission" /> and they departed to rendezvous with Koon.<ref name="Nomad Droids">{{TCW|Nomad Droids}}</ref>

===Rescue on Kadavo===
{{Quote|Yeah! That got 'em. Good work, General!''"<br />"''Keep your focus, Warthog. Watch out for those towers!|Warthog and Plo Koon|<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" />}}
[[File:CloneZ-95-EscapeKadavo.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Warthog's Z-95 starfighter is damaged by HH-87 Starhoppers at the Kadavo facility.]]
After the Confederacy facilitated the capture and [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] of a number of [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] colonists from the planet [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]],<ref name="Kidnapped">{{TCW|Kidnapped}}</ref> the Republic launched an operation to rescue them from subjugation by the [[Zygerrian Slave Empire/Legends|Zygerrian Slave Empire]]. After Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano [[Mission to Zygerria/Legends|infiltrated]] the Slave Empire, they discovered that the Togrutas were being held at a [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|slave processing facility]] on [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]], and they called in Koon and the 104th Battalion as reinforcements to [[Battle of Kadavo/Legends|liberate]] the slaves. Being attached to a 104th [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]] squadron of [[Clone Z-95 starfighter/Legends|clone Z-95 starfighters]], Warthog was dispatched aboard<ref name="Escape from Kadavo">{{TCW|Escape from Kadavo}}</ref> [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Coburn/Legends|Coburn's]] ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]<ref name="Encyclopedia: Coburn">{{SWE|characters|admiralcoburn|Admiral Coburn}}</ref> to the [[Kadavo system/Legends|Kadavo system]]. Upon their emergence from hyperspace, Warthog left the Star Destroyer's flight deck aboard a Z-95 starfighter, heading for the slave facility alongside Koon and the Wolfpack.<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" /> Leading the starfighter assault with Koon,<ref name="Explore: Escape from Kadavo">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/escape-from-kadavo-episode-guide|text="Escape from Kadavo" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> Warthog was tasked alongside his comrades with eliminating the air defenses of the facility, which was suspended over a [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] crater, so that Coburn could bring in the [[Arquitens-class light cruiser/Legends|''Arquitens''-class light cruiser]]<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" /> [[Hand of Justice/Legends|''Hand of Justice'']]<ref name="TCWEG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref> to retrieve the Togrutas.<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" />

The [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] defenses soon grew from the facility's [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shielded]] [[Autoturret/Legends|turret]] towers to [[HH-87 Starhopper/Legends|HH-87 Starhoppers]], which were launched to do battle with the Republic starfighters. One of the enemy Starhoppers landed a hit on Warthog's starfighter, damaging a portion of his wing between the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] and port [[Engine/Legends|engine]]. Noticing the struggling Warthog, Koon briefly cut his interceptor's engines, maneuvering behind the Starhoppers and firing upon them. Koon shot down one of the Zygerrian fighters, earning Warthog's thanks. Although the Republic starfighters were unable to take out the [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] towers due to their [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]], Skywalker addressed that issue by commandeering one of the turrets and turning it against the others. While Warthog and his fellow pilots continued to circle the facility, Coburn moved in with the ''Hand of Justice'', allowing Wolffe and his men to rescue the Togrutas from their holding cell, which had been opening onto the crater below. Once Coburn's [[Light cruiser/Legends|vessel]] was clear of the facility, Koon ordered the Republic's LAAT/i gunships to open fire on the enemy station, compromising its supports and dropping it into the crater. With their mission a success, Warthog, Koon, and their comrades pulled out from Kadavo, and the Togrutas were brought aboard Coburn's [[Warship/Legends|warship]] for medical treatment.<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I hope you got a lot of credits with the brewers on Coruscant, Warthog!''"<br />"''We live through this and I'll buy you all the drinks you want, Tracer!|Tracer and a relieved Warthog, upon executing their precision hyperspace jump to bypass the Gwori blockade|<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" />}}
[[File:Warthog_detail.png|thumb|right|180px|A veteran pilot, Warthog used customized Phase II armor.]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] clone<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> of the Grand [[Army/Legends|Army]] [[Clone template/Legends|template]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="Encyclopedia: Clones" /> Warthog stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] high<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and tan skin.<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" /> A veteran pilot and [[Ace/Legends|ace]], Warthog possessed considerable skill in combat operations.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> He was a member of Hunter Squadron, a Republic Navy unit that enjoyed a high mission success rate, even for so-called "no returner" assignments.<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" /> Although Hunter Squadron was reputed for piloting BTL-B Y-wing starfighters,<ref name="DB Y-wing" /> the highly capable Warthog was also comfortable with flying a number of other vessels, including the V-19 Torrent interceptor, the LAAT/i gunship, and the agile clone Z-95 starfighter.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> He formed a close friendship with his Y-wing tail gunner, Tracer, and the two pilots bet on drinks over their mission to Gwori. During that operation, Warthog was so relieved with the success of their precision hyperspace jump that he almost promised to forgo their bet. He urged Tracer to hang in there after the latter was injured by enemy fire, but Tracer died from his wound.<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" />

Serving under Jedi General Plo Koon, Warthog built up a close relationship with his [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] throughout their mutual service on the front lines,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> being his wingman at the First Battle of Felucia<ref name="Holocron Heist Ep Guide" /> and leading a starfighter assault on Kadavo alongside the Jedi Master.<ref name="Explore: Escape from Kadavo" /> Koon saved Warthog from pursuant enemy craft on a number of occasions,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> including at Felucia<ref name="Holocron Heist" /> and Kadavo,<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" /> and the clone pilot was only too happy to repay the courtesy.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Warthog exhibited a sarcastic sense of humor,<ref name="Mercy Mission" /> which caused him&mdash;in addition to weariness and his previous service on various worlds<ref name="Encyclopedia" />&mdash;to comment cynically about Aleen and its inhabitants while on a mercy mission there. He spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]].<ref name="Mercy Mission" />

==Equipment==
[[File:WarthogOnKadavo-EfK.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Warthog in Phase II armor]]
During the Battle of Gwori,<ref name="FF-2014 18: Y-wing">{{FactFile2014|18|YWI 3-4|BTL-B Y-wing Starfighter}}</ref> Warthog sported the standard pilot version of [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]], with yellow markings and the red insignia of the Galactic Republic on his helmet.<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" /> By the time of the First Battle of Felucia, Warthog adopted a customized suit of Phase I [[Armor/Legends|armor]], with his helmet featuring a black [[Bird/Legends|bird]] emblem.<ref name="Holocron Heist" /> He did not make the jump to [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II armor]] immediately,<ref name="Mercy Mission" /> but when he did, he carried over a variation of his black helmet markings, incorporating them into his new gear.<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" /> All of his armor suits<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" /><ref name="Holocron Heist" /><ref name="Escape from Kadavo" /> were equipped with vital sign [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]].<ref name="TCWCE">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|So we got another ''no returner'' mission. How is it ''we're'' on the list for all the tough jobs?''"<br />"''<nowiki>'</nowiki>Cause we never miss, Warthog. I'll bet you drinks for ten rotations we come out of this without a scratch.|Warthog and Tracer, being introduced into ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in ''Shipyards of Doom''|<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" />}}
The character of Warthog first appeared in [[September]] [[2008]] in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] ''[[The Clone Wars: Shipyards of Doom]]'', which was drawn by the [[Fillbach Brothers]] and written by [[Henry Gilroy]], the Head Writer for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" /> Warthog was incorporated into the television series in the episode "[[Holocron Heist]]," which aired on [[October 2]], [[2009]] as part of the premiere of the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]].<ref name="Holocron Heist Ep Guide" /> He was later featured in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] episodes "[[Mercy Mission (episode)|Mercy Mission]]"<ref name="Explore: Mercy Mission" /> and "[[Escape from Kadavo]],"<ref name="Explore: Escape from Kadavo" /> which were released in [[October]] [[2011]]<ref name="Explore: Mercy Mission" /> and [[January]] [[2012]], respectively. The latter episode debuted a new Phase II armor model for him,<ref name="Explore: Escape from Kadavo" /> as all of the series' clone trooper characters were upgraded to Phase II for the fourth season.<ref name="SW Blog: Comic-Con 2011 Recap">{{OfficialBlog|url=2011/07/23/comic-con-2011-the-clone-wars-season-4-panel|text=Comic-Con 2011: The Clone Wars Season 4 Panel Recap}}</ref><ref name="Explore: Darkness on Umbara">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/darkness-on-umbara-episode-guide|text="Darkness on Umbara" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> Warthog was portrayed by voice actor [[Dee Bradley Baker]] in the television series.<ref name="Holocron Heist Ep Guide" /><ref name="Mercy Mission" /><ref name="Escape from Kadavo" /> As part of his appearance in "Escape from Kadavo," Warthog received an [http://www.starwars.com/explore/encyclopedia/characters/warthog entry] in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Encyclopedia (StarWars.com)|Encyclopedia]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> As far as merchandising, a figure of Warthog was released in the "Y-Wing Scout Bomber" set of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|''The Clone Wars'' toy line]].<ref name="Hasbro: Y-Wing Scout Bomber" />
